import.title: Import sites from a CSV file
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MiB.
import.hint: A header line, separator ";" or ",". Columns code (or codeMag) and name (or nameMag); city and contact optional; every other column becomes a value of the site. An empty cell keeps the value of the site. Nothing is written before you apply.

importRefused.header_missing: The file has no header line.
importRefused.code_column_missing: The file has no column code (or codeMag).
importRefused.name_column_missing: The file has no column name (or nameMag).
importRefused.duplicate_column: A column appears twice in the header.
importRefused.column_invalid: A column cannot be a value of a site (a letter, then letters, digits or _).

issue.columns_mismatch: The line does not have as many columns as the header
issue.too_many_sites: Too many sites in this tenant
issue.values_too_large: The values of the site exceed 64 KB

sheet.title: Enroll a phone at {{name}}
sheet.intro: A printable sheet with a QR code: the phones that scan it are enrolled, attached to the site and filed in its group.
sheet.label: Label
sheet.replaceWarning: The previous sheet of the site stops working as soon as this one is created.

sheet.replaced_other: The {{count}} previous sheets of the site no longer work.
sheet.onceWarning: The QR code is shown only once: print the sheet before closing this window. Keep it out of public reach: it enrolls phones into your fleet.
sheet.heading: Phone enrollment sheet
sheet.apkQrAlt: QR code of the agent download link
sheet.step1: Install Obligarth Agent: on the phone, open Chrome at {{url}} (or scan the small QR code), then install the downloaded file.
sheet.step1NoUrl: Install Obligarth Agent on the phone (ask your IT department for the link).
sheet.step3: Tap "Scan the enrollment QR code" and point the camera at the QR code of this sheet.
sheet.step4: Tap "Activate" to allow the management of the phone.
sheet.footer: Keep this sheet out of public reach: it enrolls phones into the fleet of your company. A new sheet for the site replaces it.

screen.onceWarning: The QR code is shown only once: once this window is closed, create a new one. Do not show it to anyone outside the company: it enrolls phones into your fleet.
